statement:
∀ (c ε : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < ε →
      ∀ (N : ℕ),
        c / (↑N + 2) < ε →
          0 ∉ ⋃ n, Ioo (c / (↑n + 2)) c ∧
            c ∉ ⋃ n, Ioo (c / (↑n + 2)) c ∧ Icc 0 c ⊆ Ioo (-ε) ε ∪ Ioo (c - ε) (c + ε) ∪ Ioo (c / (↑N + 2)) c

# name: set-closed-cover-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.closed_interval_cover
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '1/2', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)', '2', '(by norm_num)'], True, "have key : ∀ (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hN : c / (N + 2) < ε), (0 : ℝ) ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ c ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ Icc 0 c ⊆ Ioo (-ε) ε ∪ Ioo (c - ε) (c + ε) ∪ Ioo (c / (N + 2)) c := by
  intro c ε hc hε N hN
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n h; exact absurd h (not_lt.2 (by positivity))
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n _ h; exact lt_irrefl c h
  · intro x ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Ioo]
    by_cases hx : x < ε
    · left; left; exact ⟨by linarith, hx⟩
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | h1'
      · left; right; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · right; exact ⟨by linarith, h1'⟩
exact @key (1) (1/2) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num)) (2) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['1', '1/10', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)', '10', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hN : c / (N + 2) < ε), (0 : ℝ) ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ c ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ Icc 0 c ⊆ Ioo (-ε) ε ∪ Ioo (c - ε) (c + ε) ∪ Ioo (c / (N + 2)) c := by
  intro c ε hc hε N hN
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n h; exact absurd h (not_lt.2 (by positivity))
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n _ h; exact lt_irrefl c h
  · intro x ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Ioo]
    by_cases hx : x < ε
    · left; left; exact ⟨by linarith, hx⟩
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | h1'
      · left; right; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · right; exact ⟨by linarith, h1'⟩
exact @key (1) (1/10) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num)) (10) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['2', '1', '(by norm_num)', '(by norm_num)', '1', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) (hN : c / (N + 2) < ε), (0 : ℝ) ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ c ∉ ⋃ n : ℕ, Ioo (c / (n + 2)) c ∧ Icc 0 c ⊆ Ioo (-ε) ε ∪ Ioo (c - ε) (c + ε) ∪ Ioo (c / (N + 2)) c := by
  intro c ε hc hε N hN
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n h; exact absurd h (not_lt.2 (by positivity))
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, not_exists, not_and]
    intro n _ h; exact lt_irrefl c h
  · intro x ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Ioo]
    by_cases hx : x < ε
    · left; left; exact ⟨by linarith, hx⟩
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | h1'
      · left; right; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · right; exact ⟨by linarith, h1'⟩
exact @key (2) (1) ((by norm_num)) ((by norm_num)) (1) ((by norm_num))"),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
